criteria.text: Every required stage and immutable secret-free resource lineage is durably persisted.
Every mutation is preceded and followed by external inspection; ambiguous responses are correlated without blind repeat.
Matching resources are adopted, conflicts fail before mutation, and replay creates no side effects.
Compensation runs in reverse dependency order and never removes adopted, pre-existing, incumbent, or ownership-mismatched resources.
Optimistic versions prevent an old error from overwriting newer success.
Running requires correlated Bahia terminal-projection lineage covering authoritative 7950/31951 inspection.
Operators can inspect, retry, reconcile, and safe-abort with non-mutating dry-run reports.
Expired failed and rolled-back state is purged by explicit retention while successful state remains.
